title: The algorithm rewards frequency. Here's a 4-post cadence that doesn't burn out.
body: Thread breaking down the posting rhythm that got the last **30 days** moving. Full breakdown in the [linked thread](https://x.com).

title: Confidence isn't loud. It's the quiet decision to stop asking for permission you never needed.
Everyone wants the following. Almost no one wants the thousand invisible mornings that build it.
The work that compounds is never the work that trends. Build the thing, not the moment.
Taste is just judgment you've earned the hard way. Nobody skips the reps.
You don't need a bigger platform. You need a sharper point of view and the nerve to hold it.
The quiet ones building in silence right now are the loud ones you'll hear about in a year.
